act_title: The Pre-conception and Pre-natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act, 1994
title: Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate proceedings of the Board
text:
10. Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate proceedings of the Board.—No act or proceeding of the

Board shall be invalid merely by reason of—

(a) any vacancy in, or any defect in the constitution of, the Board; or

(b) any defect in the appointment of a person acting as a member of the Board; or
